answer_1.quote: Word-level quality estimation (WQE) ... to identify word-level translation errors. We test three open-source multilingual MT models and LLMs of different sizes across 12 translation directions ...
answer_1.outputs: word-level error span predictions / quality estimation scores for each token

answer_2.quote: We report Average Precision (AP) as it provides a threshold‑independent measure of ranking quality ... We also test the state‑of‑the‑art supervised WQE model XCOMET ...

answer_4.quote: Human Editors. For QE4PE, we report the min/mean/max agreement between each annotator's edited spans and those of the other five editors as a less subjective "human-level" quality measure.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators highlight erroneous spans in the translation and assign a severity level (MINOR, MAJOR, CRITICAL). Agreement between multiple annotators is then measured.
